ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from modifying Completed, Active, or Inactive Account Plans
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Completed"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Active"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Inactive") ), NOT($Permission.Bypass_Account_Plan_Lock), ($User.Id <> "00560000001NBBy"), ($Profile.Id <> "00e60000001BUtMAAW")
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Account Plan is locked and cannot be modified after status is Complete, Active or Inactive.
